attestedIn.jsonPath: T4 — "And He put His tent right in the middle"
attestedIn.claim: T4 is the hinge: 'He came and stayed in a tent too — right in the middle.' Named but never voiced.

cast.notes: Described, never voiced. arc.md: 'No guide character. Cast appears as described, not voiced.' T4's note adds: do not explain this track — the pause does the work.

attestedIn.jsonPath: T3 — "The people who lived in tents"
attestedIn.claim: T3's surface reading: 'A long time ago the family lived in tents while they walked to a new home.'

cast.notes: Collective, not an individual. Referred to as 'the family' or 'our family' so the listener is inside it rather than hearing about strangers.
